verdict.rationale: AMD ships official CLI tooling in its ecosystem — AMD SMI for GPU management and Spur, explicitly described as an 'AI-native job scheduler' with Slurm-compatible CLI — but these are infrastructure/ops CLIs rather than a CLI aimed at AI-native development or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of a CLI specifically designed for AI-agent/dev workflows (e.g., code generation, model interaction, agent orchestration) and independent hands-on confirmation of these CLIs' AI-native usability.
